nodes.label: git-ana in Obsidian
nodes.summary: A Codex chat request becomes an evidence-backed analysis and an editable Excalidraw path diagram inside Obsidian-Template.
nodes.note: Scope: local skill workflow, not a remote GitHub repository analysis.

nodes.label: User invokes git-ana
nodes.summary: The skill triggers from /git-ana, a GitHub URL, repo reverse-engineering, or path-diagram discussion requests.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/SKILL.md:2-10 defines the skill, tools, and output promise; git-ana/SKILL.md:62-68 adds the visual path diagram task.

nodes.label: Read workflow contract
nodes.summary: The skill reads its workflow reference, current SKILL.md, and transplant audit rules before deep analysis.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/SKILL.md:56-60 lists Always Read files; this keeps the report grounded in current skill rules.

nodes.label: Build evidence report
nodes.summary: Phases 0-7 separate intent, origin, decisions, timeline, implementation patterns, evidence, facts, inferences, unknowns, and reproduction path.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/SKILL.md:75-85 defines the phase list; git-ana/SKILL.md:131-138 defines verification gates.

nodes.label: Extract visual brief
nodes.summary: Phase 8 compresses the text report into root thesis, main path, side-lane uncertainty, and evidence notes.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/references/workflow.md:113-121 describes the visual brief and says evidence belongs in summary or note, not labels.

nodes.label: Write vault folder
nodes.summary: The diagram source is written under /Users/saaaaa/Obsidian-Template/Excalidraw/git-ana/<slug>-<timestamp>/.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/references/workflow.md:122-126 specifies the fresh folder convention; Obsidian vault rules keep Excalidraw artifacts outside raw/ and .obsidian.

nodes.label: mindmap.json source
nodes.summary: mindmap.json is the source of truth; Excalidraw is a generated editable view that can be regenerated.
nodes.note: Evidence: mindmap/references/schema.md:1-17 defines required shape and git-ana-path as a valid layout.

nodes.label: Render Excalidraw
nodes.summary: render_excalidraw.py converts mindmap.json into raw .excalidraw, Obsidian .excalidraw.md, and manifest.json.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/references/workflow.md:127-138 gives the render command and expected artifacts; mindmap/scripts/render_excalidraw.py:575-590 implements the CLI.

nodes.label: Discuss in Obsidian
nodes.summary: The user opens the .excalidraw.md in Obsidian Excalidraw view, then refines the diagram with Codex through JSON-first updates.
nodes.note: Evidence: mindmap/SKILL.md:41-43 says delivery reports paths and updates modify mindmap.json before rerendering.

nodes.label: No invented claims
nodes.summary: A visual node must trace back to report evidence; otherwise it should become a question or be omitted.
nodes.note: Evidence: git-ana/references/workflow.md:141 sets the no-invention rule for visual briefs.
nodes.discussion_prompt: Which future diagram nodes should be promoted from question to main path after more evidence exists?

nodes.label: Template fit
nodes.summary: git-ana-path is good for route diagrams, but very dense repo reports may still need pruning before rendering.
nodes.note: Evidence: mindmap/references/layouts.md:32-48 defines framed lanes, route cards, and right-side discussion lane constraints.
nodes.discussion_prompt: Should the next iteration add multiple lanes for tech stack, architecture, and transplant separately?

nodes.label: Vault boundary
nodes.summary: The workflow writes under Excalidraw/ and should not modify raw/ source material or .obsidian configuration.
nodes.note: Evidence: AGENTS.md:54 marks .raw as legacy, AGENTS.md:80-83 lists Excalidraw-adjacent vault areas, and AGENTS.md:92-94 says raw/ content is not rewritten except ingest frontmatter.
nodes.discussion_prompt: Should git-ana diagrams later be linked from wiki/index.md or remain standalone Excalidraw artifacts?
